srList.sentence: Procedures Clinical assessment Researchers were blinded to the type of stroke when performing all procedures and assessed the patients on the Stroke Impact Scale and with Timed Up and Go Test , by the time of admission to physiotherapy ( pre-physiotherapy ) and after the treatment ( post-physiotherapy) .

srList.sentence: Statistical comparisons were made with unpaired t test ( Stroke Impact Scale , Age , Height and Weight ) and Mann-Whitney test ( Timed Up and Go Test , Last Episode , Last Physio , Brunnstom stage and Berg Balance Scale) .

srList.sentence: The average values obtained during the MVC tests was used for normalization of each muscles activation signal.

srList.sentence: Parametric variables were compared between groups using the Students t -test (i.e., Stroke Impact Scale, Sex, Age, Height, Weight and Berg Balance Scale).
